name: frameAt_real_unitary
summary: Adaptedness gives P*P = 1; square, so PP* = 1; the Gram matrix of the frame is the block form.

steps.claim: The Gram matrix of the frame at 1 is the block form B (`Space.Splitting.gram_frameAt`), so diag(s)·P = P·B.
